name: errordost
displayName: ErrorDost – Explain Errors in Urdu, Hindi, Arabic & English
description: One-click, beginner-friendly error explanations in Urdu, Roman Urdu, Hindi, Arabic or English: what it means, why it happened and how to fix it. Works offline for common errors and uses your own AI (Copilot, Claude, Ollama…) for the rest. JS/TS, Python, HTML, CSS, Java, C/C++, PHP.

enumDescriptions: Not chosen yet: ErrorDost asks the first time it runs.
اردو: Urdu in Nastaliq script, right-to-left.
Roman Urdu: Urdu written in English letters (e.g. "Yeh error is liye aaya...").
errordost.language.markdownDescription: Language errors are explained in. Leave empty to be asked on first use. Change it any time with **ErrorDost: Choose Explanation Language**.

enumDescriptions: Simple words, no jargon, step-by-step fixes. Ideal for students.
Short and technical, for experienced developers.
errordost.level.description: How detailed and technical the explanations are.

enumDescriptions: Use the first available: GitHub Copilot → Claude Code → Ollama → an API key you saved.
GitHub Copilot via the VS Code Language Model API (no API key needed).
Claude Code CLI: uses your existing Claude Code login, no API key needed.
Anthropic Claude: requires an API key (ErrorDost: Set AI API Key).
OpenAI: requires an API key (ErrorDost: Set AI API Key).
Google Gemini: requires an API key (ErrorDost: Set AI API Key).
Local Ollama server: free and fully offline.
No AI: only the built-in offline knowledge base of common errors.
errordost.aiProvider.description: AI used for errors that are not in the offline knowledge base. Only the error message and a few sanitized lines around it are sent.

errordost.model.markdownDescription: Optional model name override for the selected provider (e.g. `gpt-4o-mini`, `llama3.1`, `sonnet`). Leave empty for the provider's default. Ignored when **AI Provider** is `auto`.

errordost.ollamaUrl.description: Base URL of your Ollama server.

errordost.claudeCodePath.markdownDescription: Command or full path of the Claude Code CLI, used when **AI Provider** is `claude-code` or `auto`.

errordost.knowledgeBaseFirst.description: Show the offline answer instantly when a common error is recognized (with a button to ask AI for more). Turn off to always ask AI first.

errordost.terminal.enabled.description: Offer to explain when a command in the integrated terminal fails (needs terminal shell integration).

errordost.codeActions.enabled.description: Show an "Explain this error" 💡 quick fix on errors and warnings in the editor.

errordost.hover.enabled.description: Show an "Explain with ErrorDost" link when hovering over an error.
